It is not to brag about my work or my self, but I want to make it clear why I think we should work with these technologies and why I know that this is the right way to go…

My educational background is Computer Science and a PBA in web development from Business Academy Aarhus. I also have a Master of Science in IT with specialization in web architecture and mobile app development methods.

I have been through a lot of different technologies and different materials. I started with a lot of backend programming and mobile development. Then the web really began to rule and I dived a bit into web technologies. I was so difficult to stay tuned in all these technologies, so I decided to go with JavaScript. I could see that JavaScript really had been come a heavy hitter and the web environment was moving fast. So I started using JavaScript to build all kind of solutions: website, web apps and mobile apps. I could see that JavaScript and the surrounding frameworks and platforms were doing good. So instead of keep been updated in 5 different programming language I could do it all with JavaScript and HTML and CSS.
—> So let me show you what you can build with JavaScript!

Why did I go that way? Why didn’t I choose a master’s in computer science or a PBA in Software Development? And yes, I could have! But I wanted a hands-on approach and I wanted to work with the code and dig into programming. Web development is not the typical way to go after computer science. That would be a PBA in Software Development. But I wanted to be able to create products, user products, user-oriented products and work close with the users – user-oriented approach. And with computer science I wasn’t able to create a full product (in my opinion). And I wanted to do more web because I could see that it was tuning that way. And now we are all working on the web. In fact, I also considered Multimedia Design. But of course, Computer Science gives me a great technical background and understanding of code.
